SUBJECT: CE303 GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEERING
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.

Q.1(a) Distinguish between specific gravity and unit weight of soil solids. Any 2 points. [2] 1 4
Q.1(b) The mass of one cubic centimeter of soil in its natural state is 1.81 gm. If its mass is found
to  be  1.54  gm  after  drying  and  it  has  a  specific  gravity  of  2.7,  determine  void  ratio,
porosity, and degree of saturation of the soil as it existed in the natural state.
[3] 1 3

soil has a volume of 30 cm
3

3

calculate the specific gravity and shrinkage ratio.
[3] 1 3

Q.3(a) Describe the significance of plasticity chart. [2] 1 2
Q.3(b) A deposit of sand has porosity of 35% and G=2.65.The soil is dry in top 1.5 m depth ,15%
moisture content in next 1.8 m depth and submerged below it. Find effective pressure at
a depth of 8 m below the ground level
[3] 2 3

permeability is estimated to be about 3 x 10
